use: INAH describes the west façade’s projecting alternating head forms, sculpted sloping panels and its setting in the Ciudadela.
Official site describes four plain talud-tablero tiers and a centered stair with stone balustrades on the adjoining west platform.
Field illustrator measures an approximately square 65 m base and documents the measured rubble cap at 19.4 m and the 2.9 m sculptured course height.
The May 2026 INAH release describes the proposed future protection works. The model shows the excavated stonework and existing platform.
INAH archaeologists describe clearing the western façade and the material at its foot during early excavations.
